title: Gates as functions
hints: With bits as 0 and 1, `NOT(a)` is `1 - a`. Each other gate is one `if` / `else`: `AND` is 1 only when both are 1, `OR` when at least one is, `XOR` when they differ.
`NAND` is `NOT(AND(a, b))`. For `XOR_FROM_NAND`, follow the four steps in the description exactly and use only `NAND`.
rules: Build XOR_FROM_NAND out of NAND calls.
